product_metadata.title: Milk-Bone MaroSnacks Small Dog Treats With Bone Marrow Refill Packs, 38 Oz., 2 Count

Crunchy on the outside and meaty on the inside, our MaroSnacks dog snacks are a satisfying combo of texture and mouthwatering flavor

description: Tap into your dog’s canine heritage and treat them to a few of these savory, crunchy dog treats anytime. (These refill packs make it easy to keep the stash well stocked.) Milk-Bone MaroSnacks are dog biscuits, but with a tasty bonus: The biscuit shell encases a real bone marrow center. So they′re crunchy on the outside and meaty on the inside — a mouthwatering, satisfying flavor and texture combo. You′ll also be glad to know that they′re made with calcium and use only natural ingredients as sources of color. In short, Milk-Bone MaroSnacks dog snacks are delicious treats you can feel good about giving. Order these refill packs now to replenish your favorite dog treat canister or jar, and give your dog the simple, genuine joy that your dog gives you every day.
